definitions: Gather, collect, or clear (leaves, refuse, or other material) with a rake.
Search through (a mass of things) to find something.
Sweep (a place) with gunfire or bombs.
Pass a rake over (a surface) to make it clean and tidy.
examples: He raked the leaves into a pile.
She raked through her bag for her keys.
The machine-gun fire raked the building.
